confession.text: Main Church, 15 minutes before weekend Masses, when priests are available.

devotions.text: Rosary: Mondays-Wednesdays 9.30pm on Zoom; 4th Friday of the month 12.30pm at the Temporary Chapel
Divine Mercy: Thursdays 12.15pm at Annex Building Level 3 (except public holidays)
Intercessory Prayers: Wednesdays 11.45am at Annex, Level 2 Room 4

office_hours.text: Cathedral Office: Monday-Friday 9am-6pm, closed on public holidays.

good_to_know.text: Main Church: closed Monday-Friday; open Saturday from 4pm and all day Sunday.
Temporary Chapel (JM Beurel Centre, Annex Building Level 1): open Monday-Friday 10am-7pm.
Heritage Gallery open 10am-10pm; heritage tours can be booked at cathedral.catholic.sg/heritage.

events.title: Kerygma School 2027
events.text: For ages 18-25: opening retreat 5-15 January 2027, Saturday formation days in January and February, closing retreat 25 February-1 March 2027. Fee $381.50; register at bit.ly/kerygma2027.
